description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取A股整个市场的融资融券数据。可按时间范围查询，返回整个市场的融资买入金额、融资偿还金额、融资余额、融券卖出量、融券偿还量、融券余量、融券余额、融资融券余额、可抵充担保证金证券市值、担保物总价值、担保资金、平均维持担保比例等数据。当用户想观察A股市场整体杠杆资金、担保物规模和维持担保比例变化时，调用此接口。
description.en: Obtain market-wide A-share margin trading and securities lending data. Filters can be applied by date range, returning market-level financing purchase amount, financing repayment amount, financing balance, securities lending sell volume, securities lending repayment volume, securities margin, securities balance, financing and securities lending balance, market value of marginable securities, total collateral amount, guarantee fund amount, and average maintenance margin ratio. Call this interface when users want to analyze overall market leverage, collateral scale, and maintenance margin ratio trends.
